note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; Codex out of credits). No major; five minors. «A faithful, close rendering of the Clementine Latin: Septuagintal readings (exardescet future, in imagine, a bonis, araneam, plagas) are kept, no Hebraizing, and the pointing matches the Latin in every verse.» Passed: cometer faltas, guarda, o meu ser, todavia ×3, junto de vós ×2, Arrancai-me, porque vós o fizestes, flagelos, Perdoai-me, e já não existirei.

outcomes.remark: minor: *a bonis* is separative; *sobre* makes the good things the topic → 'e calei-me das coisas boas'
outcomes.reason: In substance: the separative with *longe do bem* (30:21, 30:12b); his *calar-se* is tacére's verb and would break the echo with 38:13b; *sobre coisas boas* stays an option.

outcomes.remark: minor: *in imágine* is 'in', not 'as' → 'o homem passa em imagem'
outcomes.reason: *passa em imagem* is not Portuguese; *como* is the build the sense takes (DRB 'as an image'); his wording is option 2.

outcomes.remark: minor: masculine *os* dangles (ea neuter plural) → 'para quem juntará essas coisas'
outcomes.reason: Mended the other way: *Acumula tesouros* gives *os* its antecedent (the treasures are what *ea* means), which also answers the blind reader's unknown *Entesoura*.

outcomes.remark: minor: the noun recast as a clause → 'qual é a minha espera?'
minor: *refrígerer* is passive → 'para que eu seja reanimado'

note: Draft 1, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; not run through Codex, by Gustavo's instruction). Nine verses; best 38:13, worst 38:3. «The psalm reads faithfully and mostly with dignity. The vós address sits naturally, and the three 'todavia' refrains give it a sober spine.» Six taken in whole or part, three refused.

outcomes.remark: 'cometer faltas' school register, slack → 'para não pecar com a minha língua'
outcomes.reason: *pecar* is peccáre's; delínquere → cometer faltas (row; 18:13, 24:7, 33:22). The Latinist passed it.

outcomes.remark: 'se postava' stiff, military → 'se erguia'
worst line: 'sobre coisas boas' a topic of conversation, colon breathless → 'e calei-me acerca do bem'
outcomes.reason: In part: *sobre* dropped and the colon shortened (*longe do bem*, the Latinist's separative); *calar-se* refused — tacére's verb (27:1), and 38:13b keeps *ficar em silêncio* for the same Latin.

outcomes.remark: 'mensuráveis' technical, 'tornastes' weak → 'fizestes medidos'
outcomes.reason: In substance, with Matos Soares 1932's *pusestes em medida* (the Latin's verb); his *fizestes medidos* is the calque of the pónere + predicate row's fault, kept as an option.

outcomes.remark: 'Entesoura' rare, subjectless → 'Ajunta tesouros'
outcomes.reason: In substance: *Acumula tesouros*; *Ajunta … juntará* would make one verb of thesaurizáre and congregáre. His wording is an option.

outcomes.remark: 'que é que' filler → 'qual é a minha espera?'
'uma afronta para o' prosaic → 'fizestes de mim o opróbrio do insensato'
outcomes.reason: The genitive taken; *opróbrio* refused — it failed two blind readers (oppróbrium row → afronta).

outcomes.remark: 'eu' adds a syllable, 'nas repreensões' trails → 'Sob a força … desfaleci'
outcomes.reason: *ego* is written in the Latin (emphatic), so *eu* stays; *Sob* makes a place of the cause (*a* + ablative); *Sob a força* is option 2. increpátio → repreensão (17:16b).

outcomes.remark: 'que eu' twice; 'existirei' abstract → 'antes de partir, * e já não serei'
outcomes.reason: In part: *antes de partir* taken; *e já não serei* refused — the bare *serei* hangs in Portuguese; *e não serei mais* is option 3.

note: Draft 1, blind, read by claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context; Codex out of credits). 37 items, 7 unknown words (Entesoura, alento, mensuráveis, insensato, definhar, postava, flagelos) — four mended. Heard rightly or within the Latin's range: *Guardarei os meus caminhos* (be careful how I live), *Pus guarda à minha boca*, *e fui humilhado*, *o meu fim* (death, purpose second), *o que me falta* (what I lack — the Latin's *quid desit*), *o meu ser*, *mas também em vão se perturba*, *Não é o Senhor?* (rhetorical), *porque vós o fizestes* (you did it), *castigastes o homem*, *Perdoai-me* (forgive, 'relent' second — the Latin's range), *antes que eu parta* (before I die).

outcomes.remark: 'se aqueceu' heard as 'was comforted'
'se inflamará' future heard as a tense slip
outcomes.reason: The Latin's future (exardéscet, ἐκκαυθήσεται); DRB keeps it.

outcomes.remark: 'mensuráveis' unknown; 'short' not heard
outcomes.reason: *pusestes em medida*; 'short' is the Greek's handbreadths, not the Latin's word.

outcomes.remark: 'postava' unknown
'Entesoura' unknown, subject inaudible; 'os' without owner
'alento' unknown
'afronta para o insensato' — direction unclear
'insensato' unknown
outcomes.reason: insípiens → insensato (row, 13:1 and 13 more places); no plainer word stays apart from *stultus*.

outcomes.remark: 'definhar' unknown; 'como uma aranha' puzzling
outcomes.reason: tabéscere → definhar (row, 118:139, 118:158); the spider is the Latin's image, kept.

outcomes.remark: 'flagelos' unknown; heard punishments / plagues
outcomes.reason: What was heard is the sense; μάστιγες = flagélla (31:10, 34:15), D15. *golpes* is option 2.

outcomes.remark: 'vaidade' heard as conceit; 'Todavia' an unclear contrast
outcomes.reason: vánitas → vaidade (row, as 4:3, 118:37); *todavia* the row's word, the Latin's adversative; *Na verdade* is option 2.

outcomes.remark: 'forasteiro junto de vós' may be heard as estranged from God
outcomes.reason: The first hearing given is the right one (a stranger living with you); *junto de* is the apud row.

outcomes.remark: 'oração … prece' heard as the same thing twice
outcomes.reason: Two Latin nouns kept two (D35); the parallelism is the Latin's.

note: ps038/revise_v2.py (draft 1 kept as prayed.v1.json): 38:2b *se erguia* (stylist; *postava* unknown); 38:3 *longe do bem* (Latinist's separative, shorter for the stylist); 38:4 *ardeu* (blind reader heard comfort); 38:6 *pusestes em medida* (unknown *mensuráveis*); 38:7b *Acumula tesouros* (Latinist's dangling *os*, unknown *Entesoura*); 38:8 *qual é a minha espera?* (Latinist and stylist); 38:9 *a afronta do insensato* (stylist's genitive, blind reader's direction); 38:14 *seja reanimado antes de partir* (Latinist's passive, stylist's *que eu* twice, unknown *alento*). Refused with options: 38:2 *pecar*, 38:7 *em imagem*, 38:12 *Sob a força* / no *eu*, 38:14 *já não serei*.

Draft 2: hard pass. 38:3 first +4 (was +6), 38:14 first +4 (the passive), 38:2 / 38:5b / 38:7b / 38:13b one colon +3; 38:12, 38:13 first −5. 38:9 no longer flagged. Rhyme 38:12 / 38:12b (*homem*) kept, the Latin's echo.
